frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The bringing-about of benefit/advantage that accrues to a recipient — the positive functional-good pole (usefulness, profit, gain that reaches a beneficiary), standing as the antonymic counterpart of ضرّ (harm).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The bringing-about of benefit/advantage that accrues to a recipient — the positive functional-good pole (usefulness, profit, gain that reaches a beneficiary), standing as the antonymic counterpart of ضرّ (harm).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 50 occurrences the root نفع denotes conferring benefit/advantage on someone — something proving useful or profitable to a recipient. This shows up as a verb (يَنْفَع "benefits X"), as an abstract noun (نَفْع "benefit"), and as a concrete plural (مَنَافِع "uses/benefits" — of cattle, iron, wine, the pilgrimage). Whether the statement is positive (faith benefited the town 10:98; the reminder benefits believers 51:55; water/ships that benefit people 13:17, 2:164) or negative (idols that can neither benefit nor harm; intercession/faith/excuse/wealth that will not benefit on the Day), the same nucleus is present: advantage accruing to a beneficiary. Negated cases still fully presuppose the concept — they deny that benefit will materialize, which requires the concept of benefit.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: N (نَفْع abstract, مَنَافِع concrete plural) nominalizes the residue as "a benefit / benefits-as-uses"; V (نَفَعَ/يَنْفَع) predicates the benefiting event on an agent-source and a dative beneficiary — both layers carry the identical residue. CONSTRUCTION: the recurrent antonymic frame ...ضرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا / لَا يَنفَعُ...وَلَا يَضُرُّ (about half the set) is a rhetorical harm/benefit dyad, and لَا يَمْلِكُ...نَفْعًا adds a power/ownership operator ("owns no capacity to benefit"); these are context, not root. CONTEXT layers to subtract: idol/associationist polemic, eschatological futility ("on that Day"), material provision (livestock/iron/hajj), and efficacy-of-admonition. Subtracting all of these leaves the stable residue: benefit accruing to a beneficiary.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 57:25 مَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ ("and [in iron] benefits for people"), juxtaposed with بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ ("great might"). Here نفع is a concrete plural noun rather than a benefit/harm event, so one might ask whether it has drifted to mere "material commodity." But it holds: مَنَافِع are precisely the useful advantages iron confers on people (لِلنَّاسِ marks the beneficiary), i.e. the reified plural of the same residue. The eschatological negations (e.g. 74:48 شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ that does not benefit) are also non-resistant: they deny the accrual of benefit, which entails the concept.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: A broader gloss "good/خير" or "help." Rejected: نفع is specifically relational and functional — advantage TO a beneficiary — not moral goodness (خير), nor aid against an adversary (نصر, which entails a conflict/opponent frame absent here), nor provision as substance (رزق). Its persistent antonym is ضرّ (harm), not شرّ (evil) or خذلان (abandonment), confirming the residue is the utility/advantage pole rather than a moral or combat pole. The harm/benefit dyad is the surface construction; the root itself contributes only the benefit pole.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinctive and falsifiable: unlike نصر (aid presupposing an enemy/struggle) the نفع frame needs only a source and a beneficiary, no adversary; unlike خير (good as quality/wealth) نفع is inherently transitive-relational ("benefits someone"); unlike رزق (provision as delivered sustenance) نفع is the abstract advantage/usefulness, which is why it pluralizes as مَنَافِع "uses." Falsifier: an occurrence where نفع denotes benefit accruing to no one, or denotes moral goodness or combat-aid with no advantage-to-a-recipient reading — none of the 50 does.
internal_discovery.rationale: Universal presence holds across every one of the 50 confirmed occurrences with no resistant case. The residue "benefit/advantage accruing to a beneficiary" is present after subtracting form (N vs V), the harm/benefit and ownership constructions, participants, and the four context clusters (idol polemic, eschatological futility, material provision, admonition efficacy). It is non-empty, distinctive against nearest roots (نصر, خير, رزق), and falsifiable. The root is near-primitive semantically, so confidence is STRONG rather than merely holding.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial refutation attempt failed to find any counterexample across all 50 confirmed occurrences (full coverage: 19 N, 31 V). Every occurrence resolves to "benefit/advantage accruing to a recipient" after subtracting form/construction/context. Five clusters, all consistent: (1) verbal لا ينفع/لا يضرّ idol-denials — 10:106, 10:18, 21:66, 22:12, 25:55, 26:73, 6:71, 2:102; (2) nominal نفع/نفعًا paired with ضرّ or in comparatives — 10:49, 13:16, 20:89, 25:3, 34:42, 48:11, 5:76, 7:188, 22:13, 4:11; (3) منافع / benefit-to-people of created things — 16:5, 22:28, 22:33, 23:21, 36:73, 40:80, 57:25, 2:219(x2), 13:17, 2:164; (4) eschatological non-availing of faith/intercession/excuse/wealth/kin — 20:109, 2:123, 34:23, 74:48, 30:57, 40:52, 32:29, 40:85, 6:158, 26:88, 60:3, 33:16, 43:39; (5) positive benefit-bringing — 10:98, 11:34, 12:21, 28:9, 51:55, 80:4, 87:9, 5:119. Antonymic-of-ضرّ framing directly attested in ~16 pairings and consistent where ضرّ absent. Distinctiveness holds: opposite pole of ضرّ, narrower than خير (functional usefulness vs general good) and رزق (provision). Residue non-empty, distinctive, and falsifiable (a single non-benefit sense would refute; none exists). Root unity intact.
